retrieve_similar_examples.note: Zero examples came back for DeepSWE queries and for a query naming a pre-existing Goodfire SWE-bench task. Admission itself is correct (334 of 334).

bare_numeric_seal_diagnosis.interpretation: [INFERENCE] The retriever drops any example whose task id contains a sealed identifier as a substring (_sealed_text). Goodfire task ids end in task-bundle-sha256-<hex>, so short numeric seals match inside the hex. This is the known CorpusRegistry.sealed_identifiers() false-seal defect (Priority #5, CE-2); this item did not change it. Not tested by removing the seals.
